_comment: Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/ShakingTable/tools/make_shape.py. Every element was made for the Seraph Horizons mod. The stand and launders (fr_*), the deck (deck_*), the differential head (hd_*: its box and pedestal; headshaft_*: its shaft, coupling and flywheel; pullrod_*: its pull rod), the rectifier (rc_*: its case; entry_*: the axle's cross), the chutes (ch_*) and the water line in each metal (pipecopper_*, pipelead_*). Keep element names when editing: the rig finds its parts by them.
